statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity.
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
The service is medically necessary to detect and correlate documented palpitations and dizziness with underlying arrhythmias.
